product_overview: A3 Laboratorio Veterinario is a staff dashboard and client portal for managing veterinary sample pickup requests, client records, couriers, billing views, results sharing, and CSV-based data loading. It also provides a customer portal for clinics to review their own requests and shared PDF results.
core_goals: Staff can log into the administrative panel and manage operational data for clients, requests, couriers, samples, results, and imports.
Staff can search and review client records, billing information, courier schedules, and sample catalogs from the dashboard.
Staff can upload and share result PDFs with clinic clients through the portal.
Clinic clients can access the portal to view their own requests and downloaded shared results.

features.name: Staff login
features.description: Administrative users can access the dashboard with a username and password session.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Fill in username -> Fill in password -> Submit the form -> See the dashboard

features.name: Client search
features.description: Staff can search the client registry by name or NIT with accent-insensitive matching, live suggestions, filters, and pagination.
user_flows: Navigate to /clientes -> Type a client name or NIT -> See matching results and live suggestions -> Apply filters -> Move through pages while preserving the search

features.name: Billing tabs and filters
features.description: Staff can review billing information in separate Facturas and Cartera views, with monthly indicators and amount/name filters.
user_flows: Navigate to /facturacion -> Switch between Facturas and Cartera views -> Search by client name or NIT -> Filter by minimum amount -> Filter by maximum amount -> Review the updated billing results

features.name: Courier cards
features.description: Staff can view and edit courier records, update availability, and create new couriers.
user_flows: Navigate to /motorizados -> Open a courier record -> Change courier details -> Refresh the page -> See the updated information saved
Navigate to /motorizados -> Fill in a new courier name and phone number -> Create the courier -> See the new courier added to the list

features.name: Weekly pickup agenda
features.description: Staff can review weekly pickup assignments by courier, move between weeks, and reassign or reschedule pickups.
user_flows: Navigate to /agenda -> Move to the previous week -> Move to the next week -> Open a pickup record -> Reassign the courier -> Change the pickup date -> See the agenda updated

features.name: Catalog and saved profiles
features.description: Staff can search the sample catalog, review prices, and manage saved custom profiles.
user_flows: Navigate to /muestras -> Type a sample name -> See matching catalog items -> Open an item for price review -> Close the item view -> See the catalog unchanged
Navigate to /muestras -> Open a saved profile -> Rename the profile -> Restore the original profile name -> See the saved profile name updated

features.name: Results upload and share
features.description: Staff can upload result PDFs, share them with the client portal, and review the mirrored Anarvet results list.
user_flows: Navigate to /resultados -> Switch between Informes and Espejo Anarvet -> Filter results by patient or clinic -> Upload one or more PDF result files -> Review the uploaded results list -> Share the results with the client portal

features.name: CSV imports preview
features.description: Staff can import prices, clients, or portfolio data from CSV files after reviewing a preview of what will happen.
user_flows: Navigate to /cargas -> Choose the import type -> Attach a CSV file -> Request the preview -> Review the counts and preview details -> Apply the import

features.name: Client portal
features.description: Clinic clients can enter with clinic name and NIT, choose a branch when needed, and view their own requests and shared PDF results.
user_flows: Navigate to /portal/login -> Fill in clinic name -> Choose the matching clinic suggestion -> Select a branch when multiple branches are available -> Submit the form -> See the client portal
Navigate to /portal/mis/resultados -> Open a shared PDF result -> Download the file

tech_stack: Telegram Bot API + Chatwoot (webhooks, not part of web UI)

known_limitations.issue: The app points to the REAL production Supabase database and the REAL Alegra account (invoicing). Tests must NOT create invoices, must not click any Alegra sync/emit buttons, must not delete or deactivate existing records, and should avoid submitting forms that create permanent data. Read-only navigation and searches are safe.
known_limitations.impact: Destructive or creative actions would pollute real client data

known_limitations.issue: Anarvet sync button opens a confirm dialog and pulls from an external database; slow and stateful
Login credentials are environment-based; staff login requires the admin user configured in .env
known_limitations.impact: Tests need provided credentials to pass the login page
